description: Change of Use from Use Class C3 (dwellinghouse) to Use Class C2 (children's home) for up to 5 children and staff
decision_conditions: The proposal for a change of use from a residential dwelling (Use Class C3), to a children's home (C2) would be contrary to Policy 6 (i) of the Havering Local Plan as there is no identified need within the borough for additional places. As there is no identified need, the proposal results in the unacceptable loss of a residential dwelling, which is contrary to Policy 3 (xi) of the Havering Local Plan.

Based on the submitted layout, the proposed change of use would not be suitable for the needs of intended occupants and based on the consultation response received as well as in the absence of evidence otherwise, it is highly unlikely that children resident in the home would attend local schools and accordingly would require home tuition. As such, the proposal would be in conflict with the objectives of Policy 6(v) of the Local Plan, Policy H12 of the London Plan as well as the objectives of the NPPF.

The proposed development by virtue of its use and scale including proposed occupancy, numbers of staff and overly intense operation would be at odds with the suburban nature of its surroundings and would result in undue harm to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers from noise and disturbance associated with the comings and goings of the use contrary to Policies 6, 7 and 34 of the Havering Local Plan, Policies H12, S1 and S2 of the London Plan and the objectives of the NPPF.

In the absence of a Flood Risk Assessment, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposed change of use would be safe from flood risks, contrary to Policy 32 of the Local Plan and Paragraph 176 of the NPPF.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reasons for it was given to the agent in writing 21/05/2026.
